questions.prompt: Why should you use 'Unpivot Other Columns' anchored on fixed ID/Name columns rather than selecting Jan..Dec manually?

options.text: New future month columns added to source spreadsheets automatically unpivot cleanly during scheduled refreshes without editing M code
DAX cannot display dates unless stored as columns

questions.explanation: Anchoring fixed columns ensures schema resilience as new periods arrive.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 1: Data Ingestion & Power Query ETL (M Language) Checkpoint
questions.prompt: What serious reporting error occurs if an Excel 'Grand Total' row stays inside a Power BI Fact table?

options.text: Power BI `SUM()` metrics aggregate BOTH line items AND the Grand Total row, silently doubling reported company revenue

questions.explanation: DAX aggregates every row dynamically—so Excel subtotal rows must ALWAYS be excluded upstream in Power Query.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 1: Data Ingestion & Power Query ETL (M Language) Checkpoint
questions.prompt: When transforming data from an external SQL database in Power Query, why monitor 'View Native Query' (Query Folding)?

options.text: It confirms filtering and joins push directly down to the fast source SQL database rather than pulling huge unindexed tables into Power BI RAM
It turns Excel tables into encrypted PDFs
It prevents calculated measures from updating on slicers

questions.explanation: Preserving query folding accelerates scheduled refreshes drastically.
questions.topic: Power BI Workflow & Power Query Unpivoting (M Language)
questions.recommendedLessonTitle: Power BI Workflow & Power Query Unpivoting (M Language)

questions.sectionTitle: Module 1: Data Ingestion & Power Query ETL (M Language) Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why did placing `'Add Index Column'` before `'Filter Date >= 2026'` cause a 50M-row SQL import to time out?

options.text: Row index numbering breaks Query Folding, forcing Power Query to fetch all 50M rows over the network before filtering locally
Dates cannot appear after integer columns in VertiPaq
SQL Server bans filtering integer indexes

questions.explanation: Apply row/column pruning first while Query Folding stays active.

questions.prompt: By default, Power Query's visual column quality preview profiles how many rows unless explicitly switched?
questions.explanation: Errors or rare nulls appearing past row 1,000 stay hidden unless full-dataset profiling is enabled.

options.text: Eliminates silent trailing spaces and casing discrepancies that break joins cleanly
Removes the need for a Date dimension
